title: On a Part Sale the dialog uses Part Sale wording
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit' and 'Part Sales — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new Part Sale for this test, Part Sale 1, for customer A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Part Sale 1.
  2. Open Part Sale 1's three-dot menu.
  3. Click Change Customer.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part Sale 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The menu lists Change Customer.

Step 3:

  • The gray caption speaks of the Part Sale.
  • It adds "Parts already on the Part Sale keep their prices, and new parts keep this Part Sale's pricing."
